skill.name: marketing-ideas
skill.description: Provides marketing ideas, inspiration, and strategies for SaaS or software products. It matches product context to relevant tactics from a 139-idea catalog and suggests practical implementation steps.
skill.summary: Generate practical SaaS marketing ideas matched to stage, budget, and growth goals.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to choose practical growth tactics for their SaaS stage. This skill maps business context to focused ideas from a 139-item marketing catalog.
actual_capabilities: Suggests relevant marketing ideas based on product, audience, stage, budget, and team size.
Uses a 139-idea catalog organized by marketing category.
Filters recommendations by stage, budget, timeline, and use cases such as fast leads or product-led growth.
Provides implementation details including fit, first steps, expected outcome, and resources needed.
Cross-references related marketing skills for plans, SEO, email, referrals, and competitor work.
Reads product marketing context files when they are available in the workspace.
limitations: It does not execute campaigns or connect to advertising platforms.
Recommendations depend on the business context provided by the user.
It does not replace market research, legal review, or financial analysis.
Detailed execution for one channel may require a specialized marketing skill.

use_cases.title: Find Low-Budget Growth Options
use_cases.description: Identify practical marketing ideas that fit a small team, limited budget, and early customer base.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Lead Generation Channels
use_cases.description: Compare paid, outbound, content, and partnership ideas for faster B2B lead generation.

use_cases.title: Shape Product-Led Growth Experiments
use_cases.description: Find referral, viral loop, onboarding, and free tool ideas that support product-led acquisition.

prompt_templates.title: Start With Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Give me five marketing ideas for my SaaS product. Ask for my product, audience, stage, budget, and team size if anything is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Rank Ideas by Constraint
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose ideas for a known budget or team limit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend marketing ideas for a bootstrapped SaaS with a small team and limited budget. Rank them by likely impact and effort.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a 30-Day Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose three marketing ideas for our next 30 days. For each idea, include why it fits, first steps, expected outcome, resources, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Map Ideas Across the Funnel
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced strategy request with multiple goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map marketing ideas for acquisition, activation, retention, and referrals. Use our stage, budget, audience, sales motion, and timeline to explain tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: We sell enterprise security software and need more leads within one month.
output: LinkedIn Ads for role-based targeting and fast enterprise reach.
Google Ads for high-intent search demand already in market.
A focused lead magnet that supports paid and outbound campaigns.

output_examples.input: We are a freemium product-led SaaS and cannot spend money on ads.
output: Viral loops that reward sharing from inside the product experience.
Free tools that attract qualified users before signup.
Community and content tactics that compound without paid media.

output_examples.input: Give me ideas for a bootstrapped analytics tool with a small team.
output: Easy keyword ranking for low-competition e-commerce analytics searches.
Founder-led emails that activate existing users and request referrals.
Partnerships with agencies that already serve the target customer.

best_practices: Share product, audience, stage, budget, team size, and current growth goal.
Ask for a short ranked list before requesting detailed execution plans.
Convert each recommendation into a test with an owner, timeframe, and metric.
anti_patterns: Requesting every possible idea without giving product or audience context.
Treating all suggested ideas as equal priority for the current stage.
Launching paid campaigns before defining conversion tracking and success criteria.

faq.question: Does this skill create a full marketing plan?
faq.answer: No. It recommends marketing ideas and starting steps. Use a planning skill for a complete strategy.

faq.question: Can it help with a very small budget?
faq.answer: Yes. It can filter ideas for free or low-cost tactics that fit small teams.

faq.question: Does it only work for SaaS companies?
faq.answer: It is designed for SaaS and software products. Some ideas may apply to other digital businesses.

faq.question: Will it run ads or publish content?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations and implementation guidance. It does not operate external marketing tools.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product, target audience, stage, budget, team size, current channels, and primary growth goal.

faq.question: Can it choose between multiple tactics?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask it to rank ideas by impact, effort, speed, budget fit, or strategic risk.
